diagnosis.label: Short delivery
diagnosis.responsible: the supplier shipped less than it billed

because.text: The goods received on the order (46) do not cover this bill (50).
Two independent counts of every photo agree, so the count is reliable.
This supplier has fallen short on an earlier order too.

diagnosis.next_step: Ask the supplier for a credit note or a corrected bill for the quantity received.
